title: Creation of a Physical Minecraft Server for the ESIG'Games Association

information.value: Associative Project - Collaboration between ESIG'TRONIX and ESIG'Games

Component sizing for the server / Assembly of the physical server / Migration of the previous online map / Addition of custom mods / Redevelopment of an exclusive mod previously available only with the online host
Physical server connected to ESIGELEC's internet network / Linux operating system / Minecraft Java Edition / Mod development in Java / Minecraft server management tools

description: As part of a collaboration between the ESIG'Games association (video games and board games) and ESIG'TRONIX, we were tasked with setting up a physical Minecraft server to reduce costs associated with online hosting.

I was responsible for the sizing of the server components to ensure stability and performance, considering the resource needs for hosting multiple simultaneous players and supporting various mods. With the help of a colleague, we assembled the server and conducted functionality tests.

We then performed the complete migration of the old map from the online server to this new physical server, ensuring the continuity of data and existing builds. In parallel, we added several mods to enrich the gaming experience and recoded a mod that was previously only available on the former host, making it compatible with our new infrastructure.

The project was successfully completed by a team of three people between May 2024 and January 2025, providing the ESIG'Games association with a high-performance, durable, and cost-effective server connected directly to ESIGELEC's internet network.
This project allowed me to strengthen my skills in server infrastructure, Java programming for Minecraft, and collaborative technical project management.
